title: hole
body:
## hole

Remove material with a real editable PartDesign Hole continuing the Body current tip. Select a Body-owned circular location sketch; marker radii do not control drill diameter. Use plain through drilling, finite flat/conical blind drilling, counterbores, countersinks or counterdrills. Depth convention, entry direction and head recess dimensions express machining intent. Every location must reach stock; threads, tapered holes and standards-derived fastener tables remain unsupported.

Native binding: `PartDesign::Hole`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `body` | one node | yes | `body` |
| `base` | one node | yes | `solid` |
| `profile` | one node | yes | `profile` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `diameter` | Positive actual drill diameter in millimetres, default 4. Sketch marker-circle radii are ignored by the native Hole. Declare this dimension once or use drive.diameter. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `4` |
| `extent` | Drilling termination: throughAll (default) passes through stock and omits depth; length requires positive depth. Through-all drilling has a flat tip and cylindrical depth convention. | `{"type":"enum","values":["length","throughAll"]}` | `"throughAll"` |
| `depth` | Positive finite drilling depth in millimetres, required only for extent length. depthMeasure chooses cylindrical bore length or cone-apex depth; omit for throughAll. May use a native length driver. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | omitted |
| `direction` | Entry direction relative to the profile normal: backward (default) cuts against it; forward follows it. A top-face location sketch normally uses backward. This is independent of world Z. | `{"type":"enum","values":["forward","backward"]}` | `"backward"` |
| `tip` | Blind-hole end shape: flat (default) or conical. Conical adds a drill point with tipAngle; throughAll permits only flat. Native properties remain editable. | `{"type":"enum","values":["flat","conical"]}` | `"flat"` |
| `tipAngle` | Included conical drill-point angle in degrees, default118, strictly between0 and180. Relevant for blind conical tips; it determines cone height radius/tan(angle/2). | `{"type":"number","minimum":1,"maximum":179}` | `118` |
| `depthMeasure` | Blind-hole depth convention: cylindrical (default) measures the straight bore and adds the cone beyond depth; tip measures to the cone apex and shortens the straight section. ThroughAll uses cylindrical. | `{"type":"enum","values":["cylindrical","tip"]}` | `"cylindrical"` |
| `recess` | Entry head recess: none (default), counterbore (cylindrical), countersink (cone), or counterdrill (cylinder plus conical transition). Declare exactly the dimensions required by that choice. | `{"type":"enum","values":["none","counterbore","countersink","counterdrill"]}` | `"none"` |
| `recessDiameter` | Head-recess diameter in millimetres, required for any recess and greater than drill diameter. Omit with none. May be driven by a named native length parameter. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | omitted |
| `recessDepth` | Cylindrical head-recess depth in millimetres, required for counterbore/counterdrill and omitted otherwise. Countersink depth derives from its diameter/angle. Blind bores must continue below the recess. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | omitted |
| `recessAngle` | Included head-recess cone angle in degrees, strictly between0 and180; required for countersink/counterdrill, omitted for none/counterbore. It controls the transition from head diameter to drill diameter. | `{"type":"number","minimum":1,"maximum":179}` | omitted |
